parameters.query: SELECT a.id AS asset_id, a.shot_id, a.project_id, a.asset_type, a.image_path, a.thumbnail_path, a.status AS asset_status, a.metadata, s.shot_number, s.shot_type, s.description, pr.positive_prompt, pr.negative_prompt FROM assets a JOIN shots s ON a.shot_id = s.id LEFT JOIN prompts pr ON a.prompt_id = pr.id WHERE a.project_id = $1 AND a.status = 'processing' ORDER BY a.created_at ASC LIMIT 50

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "{{ $env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'llama3' }}",
  "prompt": "You are an AI quality reviewer for generated images. Review each asset and assign quality scores.

Assets: {{ JSON.stringify($('Execute Logic').item.json.assets) }}

For each asset, generate:
1. overall_score: 1-10
2. prompt_adherence: 1-10 (how well it matches the prompt)
3. composition: 1-10 (rule of thirds, framing)
4. style_consistency: 1-10 (matches project style)
5. technical_quality: 1-10 (resolution, artifacts, clarity)
6. emotional_accuracy: 1-10 (matches intended emotion)
7. issues: array of strings describing any problems
8. recommendation: {pass, needs_repair, reject}
9. repair_notes: specific fix suggestions if needs_repair

Return as JSON array with asset_id as key.",
  "stream": false,
  "format": "json"
}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO reviews (asset_id, project_id, overall_score, prompt_adherence, composition, style_consistency, technical_quality, emotional_accuracy, issues, recommendation, repair_notes, reviewed_at, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9::jsonb, $10, $11, NOW(), NOW())
UPDATE assets SET status = CASE WHEN $2 = 'pass' THEN 'passed' WHEN $2 = 'needs_repair' THEN 'needs_repair' ELSE 'rejected' END, quality_score = $3, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1
INSERT INTO events (project_id, event_type, payload, created_at) VALUES ($1, 'quality_review_complete', $2::jsonb, NOW())

values.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ total_reviewed: $('Execute Logic (Review)').item.json.total_reviewed, passed: $('Execute Logic (Review)').item.json.passed, needs_repair: $('Execute Logic (Review)').item.json.needs_repair, rejected: $('Execute Logic (Review)').item.json.rejected }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'reviewed', total_reviewed: $('Execute Logic (Review)').item.json.total_reviewed, passed: $('Execute Logic (Review)').item.json.passed, needs_repair: $('Execute Logic (Review)').item.json.needs_repair, rejected: $('Execute Logic (Review)').item.json.rejected }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'error', message: 'No assets found for review' }) }}
